title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a GCP DevOps Engineer to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.

Only resumes in English will be reviewed. All interviews will be in English only (must be fluent)


We are seeking a highly skilled GCP DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in containerization, serverless architectures, and leveraging GitLab CI/CD for full lifecycle automation, from infrastructure provisioning to application deployment.


Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Architecture & Development: Design and deploy applications using core GCP services, including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions
  • Data Services: Manage and optimize data persistence and analysis using Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery.

  • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build and maintain sophisticated, multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, utilizing GitLab Runners and Docker containers for seamless delivery.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and manage security best practices using Identity and Access Management (IAM) and centralize sensitive information with Secret Manager.
  • Integration & Automation: Securely configure and automate the connection between GitLab CI/CD and GCP resources, specifically by building container images, pushing them to Artifact Registry, and managing deployments via Cloud Deploy or direct service commands.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT Infrastructure related experience.

  • GCP DevOps experience and strong understanding of GCP cloud infrastructure
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture, specifically with GCP, including hands-on experience with GCP services like App Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and Cloud SQL.

  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Professional certification in Google Cloud Platform is highly preferred (e.g., Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: Creative Designer
description:
About Us:


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We also publish Case Studied, a marketing newsletter with 40,000+ subscribers that breaks down standout campaigns and creative strategies. It’s become a trusted resource for marketers at brands like Shopify, Dr. Squatch, and Magic Spoon—and it’s a core growth engine for Vendry.


The Role:


We’re looking for a Creative Designer to own the visual output across Vendry and Case Studied. This is a hands-on production role—you’ll be responsible for designing the ads that drive our newsletter growth, producing and editing video content, sourcing and managing UGC creators, and designing landing pages and creative assets across the organization.


You’ll work directly with the founder and be the single creative resource for a fast-growing company. That means high ownership, fast feedback loops, and real impact—the ads you design directly drive the pipeline that powers our business.


We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running with Meta ad creative for newsletter growth and expand from there.


Responsibilities:


Ad Creative Production

  • Design 6–8+ static and video ad concepts per month for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns promoting Case Studied and Vendry.
  • Create ads across proven formats: text-over-video, fake social proof (tweets, DMs, Slack messages), aspirational copy overlays, carousels, and AI-assisted imagery.
  • Iterate on top-performing creatives with fresh hooks, visuals, and B-roll to combat ad fatigue and maintain performance.
  • Stay current on organic social trends (especially TikTok and Instagram) and translate them into paid ad concepts that feel native.

Video & UGC

  • Source, brief, and manage UGC creators—writing scripts, coordinating production, and editing final deliverables.
  • Edit short-form video content for ads, including cuts, text overlays, captions, and sound design.
  • Maintain a roster of vetted creators and continuously identify new talent to keep content fresh.

Landing Pages & Web Design

  • Design and build landing pages for ad campaigns, lead magnets, and conversion funnels (experience with Webflow, Beehiiv, or similar tools preferred).
  • A/B test landing page layouts, headlines, and CTAs to improve conversion rates.

Brand & Organizational Creative

  • Produce creative assets across the company as needed: sales decks, social content, email templates, event materials, and internal documents.
  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity for both Case Studied and Vendry, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint.

Nice to Have: Brand Expansion

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Vendry brand—identifying opportunities to elevate our visual presence, refine our design system, and strengthen brand recognition as we scale.


Qualifications:


Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in creative/graphic design with a strong portfolio of ad creative work.
  • Demonstrated experience designing ads for newsletters, B2B, and/or SaaS companies is a must. We need someone who understands performance creative in these contexts, not just general graphic design.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects), and/or Canva Pro.
  • Strong video editing skills—comfortable cutting short-form content, adding text overlays, and producing polished ad-ready video.
  • Experience with UGC—sourcing creators, writing briefs/scripts, and managing production workflows.
  • Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices: aspect ratios, safe zones, hook strategies, ad fatigue cycles, and format requirements.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal). You’ll collaborate daily with a North American team and need to write ad copy, briefs, and creative rationale clearly.
  • Highly organized and self-directed—able to manage your own production calendar, hit deadlines consistently, and work asynchronously across time zones.


Preferred


  • Experience working with landing page builders (Webflow, Beehiiv, Unbounce, or similar).
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics (CTR, CPL, CVR, CPM) and how creative decisions impact them.
  • Experience at a startup, agency, or in a role where you were the sole/primary designer supporting a growing team.
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills.


Why Join Vendry:


This is a rare opportunity to be the creative engine behind a company that’s growing fast and punches well above its weight. title: Cientista de Dados (Produto RH)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.

  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.

  • Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior (Python/Angular/AWS)


A Elumini está com uma oportunidade para atuar em um squad interno, alocado em um projeto estratégico para um cliente do setor financeiro.

Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior com forte atuação em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (AWS) e experiência em projetos de média e alta complexidade.


O que esperamos:


✔ Sólida experiência em definição, evolução e sustentação de arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras na AWS

✔ Domínio de serviços como S3, IAM, EC2, RDS, Lambda e API Gateway

✔ Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Python, atuando na construção de APIs, serviços e integrações cloud-native

✔ Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend com Angular

✔ Vivência com FastAPI ou Flask

✔ Experiência com microsserviços

✔ Integração com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais

✔ Boas práticas de organização de código, testes automatizados e versionamento


Diferencial estratégico:


Perfil com capacidade analítica para avaliar arquiteturas complexas, decompor componentes, identificar riscos e dependências, além de orientar decisões técnicas.

Também buscamos alguém que atue em colaboração com o time, apoiando na definição de padrões, organização das entregas, garantindo alinhamento entre negócio e tecnologia.


Início imediato

Projeto no segmento financeiro

Atuação em squad interno da Elumini


Se você busca protagonismo técnico, ambiente desafiador e espaço para influenciar decisões arquiteturais, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade!


Onde? 100% remoto


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.


Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe
description:
Atribuições:

  • Levantar requisitos do negócio junto às áreas solicitantes para o entendimento e mapeamento das necessidades;
  • Executar o desenvolvimento do projeto físico, por meio da especificação e codificação de programas, segundo modelo definido em conjunto com a área de arquitetura de sistemas, em projetos ou sustentação dos sistemas;
  • Desenvolver projetos ou atendimentos de alta complexidade, compreendendo a análise da solicitação, definição de requisitos técnicos e prazo e observando os padrões estabelecidos, para aprovação do usuário.
  • Executar testes individuais e integrados de programas e sistemas, incluindo Roteiros de teste e preparação da massa de dados, para verificação de padrões de funcionamento e do atendimento à solicitação do usuário;

  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, apoiando a equipe de operação, monitorando o resultado produzido, para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Identificar possíveis pontos de problemas de infraestrutura, performance ou falhas de sistemas e propor soluções/melhorias, de modo a eliminar problemas no ambiente a curto/médio/longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho de sistemas, serviços e componentes, objetivando a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Experiência nas várias fases de um projeto de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Conhecimento ambiente IBM, desenvolvimento em linguagem Cobol e Banco de Dados DB2;
  • Conhecimentos em processos Devops, qualidade de código, testes unitários;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos.

title: Gerente Comercial – Infraestrutura de Data Center (Brasil)
description:
Gerente de Vendas – Equipamentos para Data Center (Brasil)

Job Title：Gerente Comercial – Infraestrutura de Data Center (Brasil)

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto (online)

Tipo de vaga: Meio período (horário flexível)

Região: Brasil


1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall (Solution Mall - Global Product & Solution Services) é uma plataforma global B2B de comércio transfronteiriço que oferece produtos profissionais e soluções técnicas integradas. Ajudamos clientes a transformar necessidades em resultados entregues por meio de um fluxo online que inclui levantamento de requisitos, definição/matching de soluções, coordenação de fornecimento e suporte de entrega .

No setor de data centers, atuamos com foco em entrega de solução em nível de sistema , e não apenas venda de produtos isolados. Disponibilizamos materiais estruturados (guias de seleção, modelos de levantamento de necessidades e insights práticos) para reduzir riscos e melhorar a qualidade da entrega.


2) Resumo da Função

Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de Vendas / Parceiro(a) de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (meio período) com foco em equipamentos e infraestrutura de data center (IDC) no Brasil.

Sua missão é identificar oportunidades qualificadas, convertê-las em RFQs/cotações , e apoiar o fechamento de contratos com suporte das equipes técnicas e de delivery da SolutionMall.

Perfis típicos de clientes/parceiros:

● Operadores de data center, colocation e equipes de IT/Facilities corporativas

● Integradores, empresas MEP, EPC/engenharia, prestadores de serviços técnicos

● Distribuidores/revendedores atuando em projetos de data center

Modelo de remuneração: Comissão (2%–4% do valor do contrato, mínimo 2% ; depende da categoria e do tipo de projeto)


3) Principais Responsabilidades

A) Desenvolvimento de Negócios (B2B)

● Identificar e engajar prospects qualificados no ecossistema de data centers (operadores, empresas, integradores, EPC/MEP, prestadores).

● Qualificar oportunidades: requisitos, stakeholders, escopo, cronograma e sinais de orçamento.

● Converter demanda em oportunidades acionáveis: iniciar RFQs e coletar informações necessárias do projeto (perfil do site, capacidade, restrições, compliance).

B) Estruturação de Solução & Suporte a RFQ/Cotação

● Trabalhar com as equipes da SolutionMall para traduzir requisitos em pacotes estruturados de cotação (BOM quando necessário).

● Apoiar o matching de solução nas categorias de data center, por exemplo:

○ Energia/Power: UPS, baterias, PDU, ATS/STS, distribuição elétrica, aterramento/acessórios

○ Refrigeração: precisão (precision cooling), contenção, gestão de fluxo de ar, acessórios

○ Racks & infraestrutura física: racks/armários, contenção, organização/gestão de cabos

○ Cabeamento & conectividade: fibra/cobre, patch panels, acessórios de cabeamento estruturado

○ Monitoramento & operação: sensores, monitoramento ambiental, componentes relacionados a DCIM (dependendo do projeto)

● Coordenar prazos, documentação técnica e alinhamento de entrega com compradores/parceiros.

C) Colaboração com Parceiros (quando aplicável)

● Identificar e integrar parceiros locais (integradores, service partners, revendedores) quando isso melhorar a entrega.

● Habilitar parceiros com guias e templates para elevar a qualidade dos leads e a taxa de conversão.

D) Disciplina de Pipeline & Feedback de Mercado

● Manter controle básico do pipeline (etapa, decisores, próximos passos, riscos).

● Compartilhar feedback do mercado: expectativas de preço, preferências de compra, concorrentes e verticais com maior potencial.


4) Requisitos

Obrigatórios

● 2+ anos em vendas B2B / desenvolvimento de negócios / venda consultiva de soluções (experiência em data center / infraestrutura de TI é fortemente desejável).

● Confortável com vendas consultivas: qualificação, descoberta, RFQ/cotação e follow-up disciplinado.

● Boa comunicação e execução confiável em ambiente 100% remoto.

● Português fluente (escrito e falado).

Diferenciais

● Experiência com: UPS, PDU, racks, refrigeração, cabeamento estruturado, monitoramento, projetos MEP/EPC de data center.

● Rede com operadores de DC, integradores, EPC/MEP, prestadores técnicos ou compradores IT/Facilities.

● Inglês é um diferencial para coordenação internacional.

Estilo de trabalho

● Autonomia, consistência no follow-up, confortável com modelo por desempenho.

● Capaz de manter registros simples (estilo CRM).


5) Métricas de Desempenho

● Reuniões qualificadas e oportunidades validadas por mês

● RFQs/cotações suportadas (quantidade + qualidade do levantamento de requisitos)

● Negócios fechados (valor de contrato)

● Qualidade de onboarding de parceiros (quando aplicável)

● Qualidade do pipeline e disciplina de follow-up


6) Remuneração & Apoio

Comissão

● 2%–4% do valor do contrato (mínimo 2%) , conforme categoria e tipo de projeto.

● Pagamento alinhado ao contrato confirmado e marcos de pagamento (conforme termos de entrega).

Ajuda mensal (por desempenho/atividade)

Para apoiar colaboradores ativos com custos de prospecção e coordenação, podemos oferecer uma ajuda mensal de USD 300–500 quando houver atividade mínima mensal (exemplos):

● Prospecção e follow-up consistentes, e

● Um número mínimo de oportunidades qualificadas/RFQs registradas no pipeline, ou

● Um número mínimo de conversas de onboarding de parceiros (quando aplicável)

Observação: a ajuda mensal é destinada a custos relacionados ao trabalho (comunicação/ferramentas/transporte) e é revisada mensalmente, sujeita à conformidade local.

Certificação oficial

● Após o início efetivo da colaboração, emitiremos uma certificação oficial de Sales / Cooperation Manager e um status verificado no nosso sistema interno.


7) Cobertura (Brasil)

Atuação no Brasil, com foco em oportunidades onde você já tenha relacionamento ou acesso ao ecossistema de data centers (operadores, integradores, EPC/MEP, distribuidores).


8) Como se candidatar

1. Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e adicione uma nota de 1 linha com seu foco, por exemplo:

● “Power (UPS/PDU)” ou “Cooling & contenção” ou “Racks & cabeamento”

OU

2. Envie seu CV para:

Assunto: Sales Manager – Equipamentos para Data Center (Brasil)

Não é necessário compartilhar nomes de clientes, projetos, crachás ou informações confidenciais.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.


DON'T USE AI FOR QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS -

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

description:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

  • At least ten years of professional experience in successfully executing and managing complex IT projects (including Logistic integration Projects);

  • Strong experience in project management methodologies (classic and agile);

  • PMP certification;

What do we have to offer you?

  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Head of Community
description:
Warmy.io — Remote | Global | B2B SaaS | AI

Warmy is not building “a community.”

We are building the home of email deliverability on the internet.

If someone works in email — agencies, SDR leaders, founders, growth teams, ESPs — we want one natural place they belong.

That place is Warmy.

We’re looking for a builder. A connector. A natural networker.


Someone who can turn customers into advocates, strangers into members, and conversations into movements.

If you’ve ever thought: “I could build the HubSpot of deliverability communities” — this role is for you.

About Warmy

Warmy is a revolutionary AI-powered email deliverability platform helping companies land in the inbox, not spam. We serve customers worldwide and are scaling fast with a fully remote international team.

We move quickly. We care about impact. We measure results.

Your Mission

Build the largest and most trusted global community in email deliverability.

Not a Slack group.

Not a newsletter.

A real ecosystem where professionals learn, share, connect, and grow.


What You Will Build
  • A thriving private community (Slack / Circle / platform of your choice)
  • Programs that turn users into loyal advocates
  • Relationships with agencies, ESPs, and industry experts
  • Events, webinars, office hours, and meetups
  • Educational initiatives and certifications
  • Feedback loops between customers and product
  • Ambassador and partner programs
  • A sense of belonging around the Warmy brand

You will own the community vision from zero to global scale.


What You Will Do
  • Define and execute Warmy’s community strategy
  • Recruit and onboard high-value members
  • Create engagement systems and rituals
  • Launch and run events (virtual and in-person)
  • Work closely with marketing, product, and sales teams
  • Identify industry influencers and partnerships
  • Turn community insights into growth opportunities
  • Measure engagement, retention, and advocacy metrics
  • Be the public face of the community when needed\


Who You Are
  • 4+ years building or managing communities (SaaS, tech, or professional communities preferred)
  • Naturally social and relationship-driven
  • Comfortable speaking publicly and hosting events
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution skills
  • High ownership mentality
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — you create opportunities
  • You enjoy helping people succeed
  • You move fast and learn fast

If you love spreadsheets more than people, this is not your role.


KPIs That Matter

We are a KPI-driven company. Success will be measured by:

  • Community growth and active members
  • Engagement and participation rates
  • Customer retention and advocacy
  • Partner relationships created
  • Pipeline influenced by community
  • Brand authority in the industry


Why Join Warmy
  • Fully remote international team
  • Fast-growing AI SaaS company in scaling stage
  • High autonomy and ownership
  • Direct impact on company growth
  • Work closely with founder and leadership
  • Opportunity to build a category-defining ecosystem
  • Competitive compensation + performance incentives


The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

You might be a fit if:

  • You believe communities can change industries
  • You love connecting people
  • You enjoy building things from scratch
  • You are proactive and bold
  • You want to create something globally recognized


If you want to manage a forum — this is not the job.

If you want to build the center of an industry — let’s talk.

title: Analista Contábil Fiscal
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em um grupo eleito como a 86ª startup mais promissora do Brasil ?


A Conface Contabilidade , empresa da Dreamland Holding (que também inclui a Dream Success), está em busca de um(a) Analista Contábil Fiscal para integrar o time.


Essa é uma oportunidade para contadores que desejam crescer em uma contabilidade reconhecida pelo modelo inovador e por um atendimento verdadeiramente humanizado .


Para nós, contabilidade não é apenas enviar tributos para o cliente todos os meses. É fazer parte da vida do empreendedor , ajudando-o a crescer e tomar decisões estratégicas.


Responsabilidades (Fiscal & Contábil)


  • Apuração de impostos : ISS, ICMS, IPI, IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS.
  • Obrigações acessórias : EFD ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, ECD , ECF, DCTF, EFD-Reinf e DEFIS (e DIRF quando exigida pela legislação vigente).
  • Acompanhamento das mudanças do IVA (Imposto sobre Valor Adicionado) que passam a vigorar a partir do próximo ano.
  • Fechamento contábil autônomo : conciliações, provisões, classificação contábil, balancetes, Balanço e DRE .
  • Relatórios gerenciais e indicadores das empresas da carteira.
  • Atendimento consultivo a clientes para dúvidas técnicas (fiscal e contábil).
  • Demais atividades inerentes ao cargo.


Requisitos


  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis (concluída ou em andamento).
  • CRC ativo (obrigatório e deve constar no currículo enviado para conferência ).
  • Experiência anterior na função fiscal/contábil em escritório de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento de Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (principalmente Excel ).
  • Sistema Domínio : conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.


Nossa cultura


Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados , mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento .


Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.


Benefícios


  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses , conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado .

É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.


Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).


Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Fev/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node Senior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges


Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.

title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Product Owner trabalhará com equipes de ágeis para evolução da maturidade de produto e maximização da entrega de valor em ambiente Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Garantir a elaboração, refinamento e priorização continua o Backlog da equipe ágil de acordo com DoR estabelecido;
  • Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;
  • Interagir com Product Manager, Business Owners, SMEs e outros Product Owners para elaboração de Features e User Stories;
  • Colaborar na elaboração das Features e elaborar User Stories incluindo critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos;

  • Compreender os requisitos de segurança e compliance; estabelecer integração perfeita com as equipes de segurança cibernética e conformidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas para planejar e rastrear User Stories, critérios de aceitação e rastreabilidade de requisitos de produto;
  • Fornecer status sobre o progresso dos objetivos de negócios sob responsabilidade da equipe ágil;
  • Liderar esforços para identificação e resolução definitiva de problemas de produção;
  • Participar de cerimônias de Sincronizações do Agile Release Train (PO Synch);
  • Organizar e facilitar Sprint DEMO's para os demais integrantes do Agile Release Train;


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;

Other:
