title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

Daily Responsibilities:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving experience, combined with strong business judgment and an ability to present analysis in a clear and compelling manner;
  • Able to navigate ambiguity in work to find issues and work with the appropriate teams to fix/find a solution. ability to follow up with cross functional teams.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to work under tight deadlines and with a sense of urgency.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.


Required to work in the US PST time zone.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js / RoR)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, transparent, and fun


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in finance and/or energy, commodities, or equity trading
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software and highly secure, multi-tenant SaaS solutions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time, data-streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Ember


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:
The Conversational AI Engineer is the primary agent builder, responsible for developing and deploying intelligent conversational agents using Google Dialogflow CX. This role owns the conversation layer—from NLU model training and dialog flow implementation through webhook fulfillment and multi-channel deployment. Works shoulder-to-shoulder with the Architect on complex features and consumes RAG/LLM components built by the AI/ML Engineer. Performs preliminary technical testing on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA for functional validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement conversational flows, intents, entities, and page/route structures in Dialogflow CX based on user stories and conversation design specifications.
  • Develop webhook fulfillment services in Python or Node.js to handle business logic, API calls, and dynamic responses.
  • Conduct NLU training, testing, and optimization to improve intent recognition accuracy and entity extraction.
  • Integrate generative AI components (built by the AI/ML Engineer) into agent flows—including LLM-powered responses, knowledge retrieval, and summarization features.
  • Deploy and configure agents across channels: web chat, telephony (CCAI), Google Chat, WhatsApp, and custom applications.
  • Design and implement webhook contracts and data schemas between Dialogflow CX agents and n8n workflows (built by the Automation Engineer).
  • Build and maintain n8n workflows for agent fulfillment when scope is straightforward, escalating complex automation to the Automation & Integration Engineer.
  • Implement error handling, fallback strategies, escalation logic, and graceful degradation in agent flows.
  • Perform preliminary technical testing (conversation path testing, webhook validation, intent accuracy checks, regression tests) on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA.
  • Pair-program with the Architect on complex integrations and participate in code reviews.
  • Manage Dialogflow CX versioning, environment promotion, and agent deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning and provide technical estimates for user stories.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, chatbots, or voice agents.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Dialogflow CX (flows, pages, routes, webhooks, test cases).
  • Advanced development skills in Python and/or Node.js with experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Understanding of NLU concepts: intent classification, entity extraction, context management, slot filling.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud services: Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise APIs and SaaS platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Slack).
  • Hands-on experience with n8n (preferred) or comparable automation platforms (Make, Zapier) for building workflows.
  • Proficiency with version control (Git), CI/CD, and agile development practices.
  • Disciplined approach to testing: comfortable writing unit tests, integration tests, and conversation test cases.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder or Vertex AI Search and Conversation.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience deploying agents in multilingual environments.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text and text-to-speech services (Google Cloud Speech APIs).
  • Experience with telephony and contact center integrations.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Fully Remote position.

title: Databricks Data Architect
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking a Senior Data Architect to lead the design, governance, and evolution of our enterprise data ecosystem with a primary focus on Databricks . This role establishes data architecture standards, drives platform modernization, and partners with business and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high‑quality data solutions. Experience with other modern data platforms is a plus.


Key Responsibilities


Enterprise Architecture & Data Platform Leadership

  • Design and maintain enterprise data architecture across Lakehouse, Warehouse, and streaming environments.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing modern data platforms in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Extensive experience in designing and maintaining Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
  • Lead solution design and best practices for Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and medallion architecture.
  • Define ingestion, integration, and pipeline standards for batch, streaming, and CDC workloads.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to long‑term data platform strategy.


Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development

  • Develop and maintain subject area models, business data models, and dimensional models (fact and dimension tables) and Semantic layer design for BI and AI solutions.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, and business definitions; resolve conflicts in terminology and meaning.
  • Build and maintain enterprise semantic layers to support analytics, BI, and AI use cases.
  • Support standardization of facts, dimensions, and shared business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to design scalable, cost‑optimized, and reliable data architectures in cloud environments.


Data Governance, Quality & Metadata

  • Ensure strong data governance, security, lineage, and compliance across platforms.
  • Perform data quality assessments and identify appropriate data sources in partnership with Business/Data Analysts.
  • Maintain metadata in the enterprise repository and ensure alignment with governance standards.
  • Assist in developing source‑to‑target mappings and validating data transformations.


Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Conduct user interviews, requirements sessions, and data analysis reviews.
  • Provide architectural oversight and review solution designs across engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts to ensure consistent adoption of architectural standards.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to align data solutions with business needs.


Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data architecture or data engineering.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Hands‑on expertise with Databricks; building and maintaining medallion architecture.
  • Strong background in data modeling: dimensional, 3NF, and data vault.
  • Proficiency with Spark, SQL, Python, Kafka, Five Tran, APIs, and modern data pipeline frameworks.Knowledge of BI/Analytics/AI tools i.e., Power BI, ML Flow, Sage maker, Etc.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, BI, product, and business teams while influencing technical direction.
  • Ability to lead architectural reviews and mentor engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.Ability to influence technical, business, and executive audiences.

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.


Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.


Job Description


Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.


Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.


Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.


Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

description:
About the Role

Mosaic is a fast-growing puzzle company producing highly detailed, realistic illustrations designed for immersive storytelling experiences. We are looking for a technically strong illustrator with a realistic style who thrives in structured production environments and enjoys iterative creative processes.

This role is ideal for illustrators who:

  • Have the ability to separate personal style from production needs and iterate based on clear feedback.
  • Enjoy building complex and maximalist narrative scenes.

  • Create high-quality, detailed digital illustrations for our puzzles in a realistic style

  • Comfortable with daily feedback and multiple revision rounds
  • Production mindset and ability to meet deadlines consistently
  • Advanced proficiency in Photoshop, Procreate, Illustrator, or equivalent professional digital illustration tools


 Nice to Have
  • Experience creating artwork for puzzles, games, publishing, or complex visual products
  • Comfort using AI tools for ideation and reference gathering
  • Experience working inside structured creative pipelines


Application Instructions (MANDATORY)

Applications without ALL of the following will not be reviewed:

  • Portfolio with at least 2/3 examples of realistic, highly detailed multi-element scenes (not studies or single characters).
  • Resume or CV

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.

About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams


Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution

  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).



We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: DTC Video Editor (Health & Wellness)
description:
Company Description

We are a fast-growing, Shopify-based DTC health brand in the pain relief space, focused primarily on back pain and sciatica.

Our products are therapy-driven and positioned at the intersection of medical credibility and direct-response performance marketing.

We scale primarily through paid acquisition (Meta & Google), and long-form VSL creative (2–10+ minutes) is one of the core growth levers of our company.

Creative execution is not optional here. It directly impacts revenue.

We are now looking for a high-level Senior Video Editor who understands performance marketing and can execute long-form VSLs at a high standard.


Role Overview

You will be responsible for editing long-form VSLs (2–10+ minutes) and performance-driven paid ads across multiple platforms.

You must understand:

• Retention pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• Visual hierarchy

• Conversion psychology

• Editing for watch time and sales, not just aesthetics

You will work directly with leadership and creative direction to turn scripts into high-performing acquisition assets.


Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 3–5+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Proven experience editing long-form VSLs (portfolio required)
  • Experience editing paid direct-response ads for DTC brands
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or equivalent for motion graphics)
  • Deep understanding of retention-based pacing and performance editing
  • Ability to follow detailed creative briefs precisely
  • Ability to take feedback quickly and iterate without ego
  • High attention to detail and high production standards

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.


Technical Skills Required

You must be able to execute:

  • Long-form VSL editing (5–10+ minutes, narrative-driven)
  • Motion graphics overlays
  • Animated callouts and dynamic visual highlights
  • Anatomical overlays (not developed from scratch) and concept-explainer visual effects
  • Product-focused motion elements (outlines, glow effects, benefit visualizations)
  • Pain-point animations (ex: radiating nerve pain)
  • Clean subtitle systems and visual retention elements
  • Seamless integration of b-roll, testimonials, AI voiceovers, and UGC content

You should understand how to visually reinforce claims and concepts without making content look exaggerated or gimmicky.


Bonus Points

  • Experience editing in health, wellness, or medical-adjacent niches
  • Experience with high-spend DTC brands
  • Experience collaborating closely with copywriters and creative strategists
  • Understanding of awareness levels and performance angles
  • Familiarity with Slack, Notion, Frame.io workflows


What You'll Be Doing

  • Edit long-form VSLs used as primary acquisition creatives
  • Edit short and mid-length paid ads derived from VSL content
  • Add motion graphics and anatomical overlays to enhance clarity and perceived efficacy
  • Translate scripts into visually engaging, high-retention video
  • Maintain brand consistency across all edits
  • Iterate based on performance data and feedback
  • Deliver assets reliably and on schedule

We move quickly and expect tight execution.


Who Is This Role For?

  • An editor who thinks beyond cutting clips
  • Someone who understands that editing impacts profitability
  • Someone who takes ownership
  • Someone who wants to build high-level performance skills
  • Someone who wants their work to directly impact scaling

This is not for beginners.

This is not for cinematic YouTube vlog editors.

This is for performance-driven editors.


Compensation & Structure

  • $2,000–$3,000 USD per month (based on experience)
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Fully remote
  • Long-term growth potential


Application Process

To apply, send:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio (VSL examples required)
  • A short paragraph explaining your experience with performance-driven editing


If you are an experienced VSL editor who understands direct response and can execute at a high level, we want to see your work.


We are hiring immediately.

title: DTC Video Editor (Health & Wellness)
description:
Company Description

We are a fast-growing, Shopify-based DTC health brand in the pain relief space, focused primarily on back pain and sciatica.

Our products are therapy-driven and positioned at the intersection of medical credibility and direct-response performance marketing.

We scale primarily through paid acquisition (Meta & Google), and long-form VSL creative (2–10+ minutes) is one of the core growth levers of our company.

Creative execution is not optional here. It directly impacts revenue.

We are now looking for a high-level Senior Video Editor who understands performance marketing and can execute long-form VSLs at a high standard.


Role Overview

You will be responsible for editing long-form VSLs (2–10+ minutes) and performance-driven paid ads across multiple platforms.

You must understand:

• Retention pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• Visual hierarchy

• Conversion psychology

• Editing for watch time and sales, not just aesthetics

You will work directly with leadership and creative direction to turn scripts into high-performing acquisition assets.


Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 3–5+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Proven experience editing long-form VSLs (portfolio required)
  • Experience editing paid direct-response ads for DTC brands
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or equivalent for motion graphics)
  • Deep understanding of retention-based pacing and performance editing
  • Ability to follow detailed creative briefs precisely
  • Ability to take feedback quickly and iterate without ego
  • High attention to detail and high production standards

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.


Technical Skills Required

You must be able to execute:

  • Long-form VSL editing (5–10+ minutes, narrative-driven)
  • Motion graphics overlays
  • Animated callouts and dynamic visual highlights
  • Anatomical overlays (not developed from scratch) and concept-explainer visual effects
  • Product-focused motion elements (outlines, glow effects, benefit visualizations)
  • Pain-point animations (ex: radiating nerve pain)
  • Clean subtitle systems and visual retention elements
  • Seamless integration of b-roll, testimonials, AI voiceovers, and UGC content

You should understand how to visually reinforce claims and concepts without making content look exaggerated or gimmicky.


Bonus Points

  • Experience editing in health, wellness, or medical-adjacent niches
  • Experience with high-spend DTC brands
  • Experience collaborating closely with copywriters and creative strategists
  • Understanding of awareness levels and performance angles
  • Familiarity with Slack, Notion, Frame.io workflows


What You'll Be Doing

  • Edit long-form VSLs used as primary acquisition creatives
  • Edit short and mid-length paid ads derived from VSL content
  • Add motion graphics and anatomical overlays to enhance clarity and perceived efficacy
  • Translate scripts into visually engaging, high-retention video
  • Maintain brand consistency across all edits
  • Iterate based on performance data and feedback
  • Deliver assets reliably and on schedule

We move quickly and expect tight execution.


Who Is This Role For?

  • An editor who thinks beyond cutting clips
  • Someone who understands that editing impacts profitability
  • Someone who takes ownership
  • Someone who wants to build high-level performance skills
  • Someone who wants their work to directly impact scaling

This is not for beginners.

This is not for cinematic YouTube vlog editors.

This is for performance-driven editors.


Compensation & Structure

  • $2,000–$3,000 USD per month (based on experience)
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Fully remote
  • Long-term growth potential


Application Process

To apply, send:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio (VSL examples required)
  • A short paragraph explaining your experience with performance-driven editing


If you are an experienced VSL editor who understands direct response and can execute at a high level, we want to see your work.


We are hiring immediately.

CRFs

Profissional sénior com mais de 8 anos de experiência em integração de sistemas empresariais (EAI) utilizando o IBM WebMethods Integration Server , especializado no desenho, desenvolvimento e otimização de soluções de integração de alta disponibilidade.   • Experiência sólida com web services SOAP/REST , APIs , WSDL , Swagger/OpenAPI .
  • Integração com sistemas externos via JDBC , SAP Adapter , MQ , FTP/SFTP , JMS , Kafka .
  • Gestão e otimização de pipelines , error handling , logging , monitorização e performance tuning .

Arquitetura e Integração

  • Desenho de arquiteturas SOA , ESB , microserviços e event-driven .
  • Modelação de integrações complexas entre sistemas ERP, CRM, billing, logística e plataformas cloud.
  • Experiência com CI/CD , versionamento e automação de deploys (Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de integração (EIP), mensageria e governança de APIs.

Linguagens e Ferramentas

  • Java, SQL, XML, XSLT, JSON.
  • Docker, Kubernetes (desejável).
  • Ferramentas de monitorização e logging (Splunk, Kibana, Dynatrace).


Informações adicionais


  • Disponibilidade: Atuar no fuso horário da Europa (6h às 15h)
  • 100% home office

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Gerente de proyecto regional de pagos
description:
El candidato seleccionado deberá:


Liderar la gestión integral del proyecto de alistamiento y preparación de los países miembros del FLAR para su eventual participación en un piloto de interconexión de sistemas de pagos inmediatos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los hitos definidos, la adecuada coordinación con los bancos centrales participantes y otros actores relevantes; así como la correcta articulación de los componentes técnicos, regulatorios, operativos y de flujo comercial.


El candidato seleccionado deberá:


  • Diseñar e implementar el plan de trabajo detallado del proyecto, traduciendo los objetivos estratégicos en planes ejecutables, realizando seguimiento periódico al avance, riesgos, dependencias y posibles desviaciones, y proponiendo acciones correctivas y estrategias de mitigación cuando sea necesario.
  • Conformar y coordinar el equipo de trabajo del proyecto en articulación con las instancias internas relevantes, bancos centrales participantes, contrapartes técnicas y otras institucionales, incluyendo la facilitación de ejercicios de diagnóstico o autoevaluación.
  • Preparar reportes ejecutivos periódicos para la alta dirección; desarrollar presentaciones para comités, mesas regionales y eventos estratégicos, y documentar las decisiones clave, lecciones aprendidas y avances del proyecto.
  • Sistematizar los aprendizajes y buenas prácticas del proyecto para generar insumos técnicos y conceptuales para la Plataforma C3 del FLAR, difundiendo y socializando los resultados en espacios como workshops, webinars y foros cuando sea solicitado.


Requisitos


  • Profesional en economía, ingeniería, administración, finanzas, sistemas, derecho, relaciones internacionales o áreas afines. Deseable, posgrado en gestión de proyectos, innovación, sistemas financieros o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia mínima comprobada de 5 años en la gestión de proyectos complejos y multiactor, preferiblemente en proyectos relacionados con sistemas de pagos, infraestructura financiera o en entornos de bancos centrales, entidades públicas u organismos internacionales, y certificación en gestión de proyectos (PMP® o PRINCE2® Practitioner).
  • Niveles de idiomas mínimos requeridos: español C1, inglés C1, portugués C1.


Conocimientos técnicos

  • Dominio de metodologías formales de gestión de proyectos (PMI, PRINCE2 o enfoques híbridos)
  • Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de planificación y seguimiento (MS Project u otras equivalentes),
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de pagos, pagos inmediatos y/o infraestructura financiera
  • Conocimiento y uso estratégico de herramientas de inteligencia artificial orientado a mejorar la planificación, seguimiento, análisis y reporte del proyecto.


Tipo de contratación


Prestación de servicios, a un (1) año.



Si cumples con los requerimientos del perfil envíanos tu hoja de vida al correo electrónico .


Cierre de la convocatoria el 8 de marzo de 2026.

Essa função se concentrará na criação e manutenção de pipelines de dados usando o PySpark, com SQL como a linguagem de codificação principal. O candidato também terá uma boa compreensão das estruturas de modelagem de dados (como modelagem dimensional Kimball) e experiência no suporte a datawarehouses e data marts.

Garanta a qualidade, a consistência e o desempenho dos dados em todo o pipeline

Experiência/compreensão de Jenkins

Fluência em inglês

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática em engenharia de dados codificando consultas SQL complexas

Experiência comprovada em SQL – incluindo junções, agregações, funções de janela e ajuste de desempenho

Experiência prática com o PySpark, particularmente com o Spark SQL

Familiaridade com os serviços de dados da AWS (por exemplo, EMR, S3, Glue)

Compreensão de estruturas de modelagem de dados, incluindo a metodologia Kimball

Experiência de trabalho com Snowflake ou data warehouses em nuvem semelhantes

Conhecimento do Apache Iceberg ou formatos de tabela semelhantes (por exemplo, Delta Lake, Hudi)

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Norte
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Norte



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a GCP DevOps Engineer to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


Only resumes in English will be reviewed. All interviews will be in English only (must be fluent)


We are seeking a highly skilled GCP DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in containerization, serverless architectures, and leveraging GitLab CI/CD for full lifecycle automation, from infrastructure provisioning to application deployment.


Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Architecture & Development: Design and deploy applications using core GCP services, including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions
  • Data Services: Manage and optimize data persistence and analysis using Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop, manage, and maintain GCP infrastructure using Terraform or Cloud Deployment Manager within a GitOps framework.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build and maintain sophisticated, multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, utilizing GitLab Runners and Docker containers for seamless delivery.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and manage security best practices using Identity and Access Management (IAM) and centralize sensitive information with Secret Manager.
  • Integration & Automation: Securely configure and automate the connection between GitLab CI/CD and GCP resources, specifically by building container images, pushing them to Artifact Registry, and managing deployments via Cloud Deploy or direct service commands.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT Infrastructure related experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • GCP DevOps experience and strong understanding of GCP cloud infrastructure
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture, specifically with GCP, including hands-on experience with GCP services like App Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and Cloud SQL.
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable and secure cloud-based infrastructure for PaaS.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with automation and orchestration tools (e.g., Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Professional certification in Google Cloud Platform is highly preferred (e.g., Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Advanced English
