title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Especialista de Negócios em Geotecnologias
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional sênior e estratégico para atuar na identificação e desenvolvimento de novas oportunidades de negócio, com foco em soluções inovadoras para processos críticos dos nossos clientes e na temática ESG. Se você tem paixão por transformar desafios de mercado em propostas de valor baseadas no uso de geotecnologias, inteligência artifical e analytics, e possui experiência comprovada no ciclo de desenvolvimento de negócios, do insight estratégico à execução das vendas, esta é a sua oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa que usa a tecnologia para transformar negócios e a sociedade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Atuar como interface estratégica com áreas técnicas (Arquitetura e Soluções) para a validação, refinamento e garantia da entrega das soluções e garantindo p engajamento necessário em negociações complexas de serviços que envolvam customizações e/ou integrações.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Realizar, no papel de um especialista em tecnologia, apresentações sobre a plataforma Esri e soluções de seus parceiros para clientes e em eventos para o mercado, reforçando a proposta de valor da Imagem.



Requisitos e Qualificações

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Profundo conhecimento e habilidade comprovada em estruturar propostas de valor, modelos de negócio e ofertas técnicas complexas.

Capacidade analítica e estratégica para identificar tendências, analisar dados de mercado e traduzi-los em planos de ação e oportunidades de negócio tangíveis.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de interagir e influenciar executivos e áreas técnicas.

Sólido conhecimento em geotecnologias, especialmente plataforma Esri, e suas aplicações nos diversos mercados.

Inglês Fluente/Avançado;

Espanhol avançado será considerado um diferencial.

Formação:

Superior completo em áreas de Tecnologia (Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia), áreas de Negócios (Economia, Administração) ou em Geociências.

Formação complementar (pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização) em áreas como inovação tecnológica, transformação digital, sustentabilidade, mudanças climáticas ou resiliência ambiental será considerada um diferencial.

description:

title: Golang Data Engineer
description:
Golang Data Engineer #2613

Position Summary:


Our partner is a quantitative trading organization where live market data, low-latency systems, and proprietary models directly drive capital allocation decisions. As the platform continues to scale, the team is adding a senior engineer to own the real-time streaming ingestion systems that power live trading. You’ll build production-grade Go services that consume live WebSocket feeds, process and time-slice high-throughput market data, and deliver reliable inputs to a C-based trading engine running on AWS. The focus is demanding and meaningful: streaming reliability, automated failover, observability, and production debugging in a latency-sensitive environment where performance and correctness directly impact outcomes. If you enjoy building systems where milliseconds matter and your work influences real capital in motion, this is engineering at its sharpest.


Experience and Education:


  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience/field
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade distributed system for real-time or streaming environments
  • Strong production experience developing backend or systems services in Go
  • Experience implementing WebSocket-based live data ingestion
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, specifically EC2 and S3
  • Experience building and deploying containerized services, ideally in Kubernetes environments
  • Experience supporting low-latency, high-availability systems where downtime or delay had direct business impact


Skills and Strengths:


  • Go
  • Real-time streaming systems
  • WebSockets
  • Low-latency architecture
  • Production service development
  • AWS EC2
  • AWS S3
  • Kubernetes
  • Containerization
  • Monitoring
  • Observability
  • Prometheus
  • High-throughput data processing
  • Failover design
  • Distributed systems
  • Debugging live production systems
  • Time-series data handling
  • Data pipeline development
  • Concurrency patterns
  • Systems reliability engineering



Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Rebuild and own the production-grade, real-time market data ingestion system end-to-end
  • Develop high-performance Go services that consume live market data over WebSockets
  • Process and manage high-throughput streaming data across approximately 1,500 equities
  • Aggregate and time-slice streaming data for accurate downstream model consumption
  • Deliver structured, low-latency data feeds to a C-based trading engine running on AWS EC2
  • Design and implement automatic failover from live market feeds to delayed backup streams
  • Ensure data integrity and correctness during feed transitions and recovery scenarios
  • Maintain and validate the historical data ingestion pipeline sourcing from AWS S3
  • Instrument services with monitoring and observability to detect latency spikes, data gaps, and system degradation
  • Debug and resolve live production streaming failures with minimal business disruption
  • Optimize ingestion services for latency, throughput, and fault tolerance
  • Deploy and operate containerized services within cloud-native environments
  • Collaborate directly with technical leadership on architectural decisions and performance tradeoffs
  • Operate independently without daily direction, taking full ownership of reliability and delivery
  • Continuously improve system resilience to support live trading without manual intervention

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).
  • Garantir clareza de premissas e limites das soluções (dados, regras e critérios), com documentação e governança para adoção e manutenção.
  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Cloud Engineer (DevOps/SRE) (Colombia, Brazil, Costa Rica)
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

We’re looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong DevOps/SRE experience to join a high-performing engineering team.


Role Overview

This engineer will be responsible for all of the infrastructure and tooling.

In this role, you will support cloud infrastructure and deploy pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform .

You’ll collaborate with senior engineers to automate infrastructure provisioning, manage containerized applications, and maintain CI/CD workflows to ensure reliable, scalable deployments across multi-cloud platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation and respond to incidents professionally
  • Maintain and enhance AWS cloud infrastructure using automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines , enabling self-service and agile software development
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to solve complex infrastructure and reliability challenges
  • Continuously improving system performance, reliability, and observability


Required Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure roles
  • Experience with AWK and Kubernetes is required.
  • Strong experience with AWS or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to observability tools (DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch)
  • Ability to collaborate with teams working in PST time zone


Nice to Have

  • Programming experience beyond shell scripting (Go, Python, Java, etc.)
  • Experience debugging Kubernetes networking or performance issues
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS, etc.)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Accounting, or related fields

Advanced Excel skills (mandatory)

Proven experience managing projects and/or junior team members

Full-time availability with exclusivity

Availability to work primarily remote (home office)


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, or power sector projects

  • Compensation package negotiable based on experience and track record
  • Performance-based growth potential

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist , you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, and practical content direction to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.

You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients.

Your accountability is defined by the question: “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • - Websites
  • - Social media captions and post copy
  • - Email campaigns
  • - Campaign and promotional assets
  • - Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the provided strategy and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description


EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.


You Are


An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.


Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.


Responsibilities


  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction


Qualifications


  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference, push the change forward, and develop software critical to their success.


The Observability Enabler


The DevOps Engineer at Mojo Trek is a specialized \"Platform Architect\" who operates as a part-time strategic member of the Elite Squad. Rather than being a bottleneck for deployments, you are an Educator and Guardrail-Builder. You empower the \"Golden Three\" by setting up automated CI/CD pipelines, enforcing security/compliance standards, and enabling the deep observability (DORA/DX) that defines Mojo Trek’s success.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and maintain reproducible environments that adhere to specific platform standards and patterns.
  • Pipeline Orchestration: Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, security scanning, and deployment.
  • Observability Enablement: Own the tooling and instrumentation (logging, tracing, metrics) that allows Developers and POs to understand system health in real-time.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure the solution meets all security and regulatory requirements from day one.
  • Technical Education: Upskill the Software Engineers and Testers to manage their own containerization and basic deployment scripts, reducing hand-offs.


Qualifications

  • Platform Expert: Deep mastery of AWS, Azure, or GCP, specifically regarding container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and serverless architectures.
  • Automation-First: Proficiency in Terraform, Pulumi, or similar IaC tools.
  • Security Mindset: Experience with DevSecOps practices, including secret management and vulnerability scanning.
  • Consultative Mentor: The ability to simplify complex infrastructure concepts for the rest of the team and the client stakeholders.


RACI Profile: The Platform Enabler

  • Accountable (A): CI/CD Pipeline Stability, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards, and Security Compliance.
  • Responsible (R): Observability setup, Cloud resource provisioning, and developer environment automation.
  • Consulted (C): Scale/Performance planning (PE) and disaster recovery strategy.
  • Informed (I): Sprint-level feature releases and routine bug fixes.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior
description:

É uma posição hands-on, mas com espaço real para influenciar decisões técnicas, apoiar o time e ajudar a desenhar os próximos passos da plataforma.

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e evoluir produtos e códigos já existentes;

  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções.


Requisitos técnicos


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) full stack (mínimo de 5 anos);
  • Forte conhecimento em C#, .NET e SQL Server;
  • Experiência com Angular e React no front-end;
  • Vivência com Node.js no backend;• Conhecimento em arquitetura de software e boas práticas (DDD, desacoplamento, escalabilidade);
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria e comunicação assíncrona (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka etc.) em arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST e WebServices;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;

Perfil comportamental


Buscamos alguém proativo, comprometido, flexível, resiliente, comunicativo e colaborativo.

Uma pessoa que goste de desafios, tenha curiosidade técnica, vontade de aprender e que não se limite apenas a executar — mas que também pense, questione e ajude a construir soluções melhores junto com o time!

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Design Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for aesthetics who can catch the hottest visual styles on campus and help our products look and feel right for local users.


What You’ll Do:

● Capture Visual Trends: Continuously analyze the aesthetic preferences and popular styles among local students to guide product design.

● Localize Visuals: Help adjust marketing materials visually (like layout and cultural fit) and create visuals that align with local aesthetics.

● Be a design critic: Review our products (and competitors') from a user’s perspective identify visual or experience flaws, and give practical feedback.


We Hope You Are:

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● Think like a visual detective: not just see if something looks good—but ask why it’s designed in that way and how it could be better.

● Care about user experience: pay attention to how visuals affect usability and enjoy comparing product designs critically.


Bonus Points If You Have:

● Extensive knowledge of local visual product usage habits gained from living in regions like North America, Latam America, or East/Southeast Asia.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.


What You’ll Get:

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.


You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud , including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure , primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

title: AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts
description:
HIRING: 2 AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts

We're Not a Startup. We're a $8M Company That Just Decided to Eat the Software Market.


Contract → Full-Time | Remote | 8 AM – 6 PM EST | Monday to Saturday - Start Immediately

First, Let's Talk About Why Your Current Gig Sucks

You already know this, but let's say it out loud:


1. You sit in meetings about meetings. Three hours of \"alignment sessions\" so six people can

approve a button color. Meanwhile, we ship entire features before lunch.


2. Your PRs rot in review queues for days. You wrote the code Monday. It's Thursday. Dave still hasn't looked at it. Dave is \"swamped.\" Here? PR goes up, gets reviewed same day, ships same day.


3. You're a cog and you know it. You own a slice of a microservice that serves a widget inside a dashboard that nobody uses. Here, you own entire product surfaces end-to-end — UI, API, database, deployment. Your name is on it.


4. The \"innovation\" is a lie. They said \"move fast and break things\" in the job post. What they meant was \"move at the speed of legal review and break nothing, ever, including your spirit.\" We actually move fast. Uncomfortably fast.


5. Your tools are chosen by committee. You're stuck on Jenkins pipelines from 2017 and a Jira board with 14 custom fields. We use Claude Code CLI, Linear, GitHub, Vercel, and that's about it. Clean. Fast. Done.


6. The tech debt is someone else's mess and now it's your problem. You inherited a codebase that looks like it was written by 47 different people across 3 continents over 6 years. Because it was. We're building from scratch with modern architecture and AI-first workflows.


7. You have zero ownership. You don't know the customers. You don't see the revenue. You don't feel the impact. Here, you'll watch real call center operators use what you built and hear them say \"this changes everything.\" That's not marketing copy — that's Tuesday.


8. Your compensation is \"competitive\" (it's not). They gave you a 3% raise and called it generous. We do competitive salary + performance bonuses + profit sharing + PTO. You want to write your own ticket? Prove you're an A-player and the money follows.


9. Nobody cares how fast you are. You could ship 10x what your team does and you'd get the same review score as the person who refactored a README. We measure output: PRs merged, features shipped, products launched. Speed is the currency here.


10. You're building someone else's dream. Some VP's pet project. Some board member's \"strategic initiative.\" Here, you're building products for an industry we've spent a decade mastering — and you get a real stake in the outcome.


Who We Are (And Why You Should Care)


I've spent 10 years building and owning call centers. Not advising them. Not consulting for them. Running them. We did $8 million last year in the call center world. We know every pain point, every inefficiency, every moment where operators think \"there has to be a better way.\"

Now there is. We're pivoting to SaaS — and we're building the software suite that the entire call center industry has been waiting for. AI-powered call routing, real-time analytics, agent management, voice AI integration — the whole stack.


Our position is unfair and we like it that way:

  • We have deep domain expertise (10 years, $8M revenue, real operator relationships)
  • We have cash flow — we're not burning runway praying for product-market fit
  • We're raising capital to pour fuel on the fire, but we don't need it to survive
  • We're using Claude Code CLI to build at 5-10x the speed of traditional teams
  • We're bringing our first product to market right now , with a full suite behind it


Two developers + Claude Code + a founder who knows the industry cold = a team that outproduces companies with 10x the headcount. That's not theory. That's the plan.


The Role: What You'll Actually Do Every Day


You'll use Claude Code CLI as your primary development tool , running parallel sessions across git worktrees while maintaining production-quality standards. This isn't \"use AI sometimes.\" This is AI-first development where you orchestrate multiple coding agents and own the output.


Daily work:

  • Build features end-to-end: UI → API → database → tests → deployment
  • Run 3–8 parallel Claude Code instances across worktrees
  • Write and maintain CLAUDE.md project files and agent configurations
  • Decompose features into agent-executable specifications
  • Review, test, and refine AI-generated code for production readiness
  • Ship 2–4 PRs per day (yes, per day)
  • Record quick Loom demos of shipped features


Tech stack:

  • TypeScript (primary), Python (secondary)
  • Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Redis
  • Vapi / LiveKit for voice AI
  • Vercel + Supabase for deployment
  • Claude Code CLI — this is the job


Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years professional development experience
  • Deep Claude Code CLI proficiency — you should be able to show me your CLAUDE.md from a real project
  • Strong TypeScript + Python
  • React / Next.js production experience
  • PostgreSQL and data modeling chops
  • Git mastery: rebasing, worktrees, bisect, clean history — not just commit and push
  • Test-driven development habits
  • Excellent written English


Work Setup (No Exceptions):

  • High-end computer — your machine needs to handle multiple Claude Code instances, local dev servers, and Docker without breaking a sweat. If your laptop fans sound like a jet engine opening VS Code, this isn't the gig.
  • High-end internet — stable, fast connection. You're screen-sharing, pushing code, and running cloud deploys all day. Laggy internet = laggy output.
  • Available 8 AM – 6 PM EST, Monday –Saturday — 10-hour days. We work hard. I work 80-hour weeks. I'm asking you for 60. That's the deal.
  • Reliability is everything — show up, communicate, deliver. Every day. No disappearing acts.


Communication is IMPERATIVE:


This cannot be overstated. You need to be a clear, proactive communicator. Daily async standups. Responsive on Slack. Articulate in PRs. If something's blocked, you say so immediately — not two days later. We're a small, fast team. Communication gaps don't just slow us down, they kill momentum.


The Transparency Section

We use time tracking software. Not because we're micromanagers — because we're building trust with accountability. Honest work gets honest pay. Simple.


You work 10-hour days. Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM EST. This is a high-intensity, high-output role. We're bringing a product to market and building a suite behind it. If you want work-life balance right now, I respect that, but this isn't the role. If you want to build something massive and get rewarded for it, keep reading.


We move at startup speed with real-company cash. That means you get the excitement of building from zero without the anxiety of wondering if payroll clears next month.

What You Get


Competitive salary — real money, not \"equity only\"

Performance bonuses — ship fast, get paid more. Directly tied to output.

Profit sharing — we win, you win. Not a poster on the wall. Real checks.

️ Paid time off — because burned-out developers write burned-out code

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the planning and execution of core consumer experience initiatives, ensuring projects move seamlessly from concept to launch on mobile platforms.
  • Manage the workflow for A/B testing and feature rollouts, ensuring that data, engineering, and design teams are coordinated to deliver insights rapidly.
  • Manage trade-offs effectively to deliver measurable business impact without sacrificing technical quality or team health.
  • Use project metrics to identify bottlenecks in the development lifecycle and continuously improve how we build and scale.


Qualifications


  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Proven experience managing the delivery of mobile products (iOS/Android), with a solid understanding of app release cycles and store submission processes.
  • Background in managing projects within dynamic marketplace or two-sided platform environments where dependencies are complex.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, high-stakes projects serving large user bases, ensuring stability and performance upon launch.
  • Strong command of Agile/Scrum methodologies, specifically adapted for teams that run frequent A/B tests and iterative loops.
  • Deep intuition for resource allocation—knowing how to organize backlogs and schedules to support both immediate business objectives and long-term improvements.
  • Skilled at tracking project health metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time) and using them to predict risks and improve predictability.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US . We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India . Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!



Job Title: Application Support Engineer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Role Description: The Application Support Engineer is responsible for administering and supporting the ticketing system, as well as providing operational support, maintenance, and lifecycle management for both SaaS (vendor-managed) and self-managed enterprise applications. This role ensures applications are secure, available, performant, and compliant, while serving as a key coordination point between vendors, internal infrastructure teams, InfoSec, and business stakeholders.

Mandatory Experience: SaaS-Ticketing system, Atlassian suite, Jira. also have experience managing on-premise applications running on windows or Linux platforms that require patch and update deployment. The most important qualities are independence and a strong willingness to learn.


Job Experience Requirements:

  • 3–7 years of experience supporting the ticketing system and enterprise applications across SaaS and self-managed models.
  • Hands-on experience with application deployments, patching, and maintenance for self-managed systems.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, vendor support, and SLA management.
  • Experience with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem, request management).
  • Hands-on experience in administering and supporting ticketing systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot across applications, infrastructure, and integration layers.
  • Strong communication skills to work with vendors and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Experience supporting business-critical or regulated applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of IAM, observability, and security controls.

Job Responsibilities:

Self-Managed Application Support

  • Perform application maintenance for self-managed applications, including deployment of application updates, patches, and fixes.
  • Support production and non-production environments (dev, test, staging, prod).
  • Execute deployments following approved change management (CAB) processes.
  • Monitor application health, availability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve L2/L3 issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, and InfoSec teams for changes and remediation.

SaaS (Managed Service) Application Support

  • Act as the primary IT point of contact for SaaS applications managed by external vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support escalations, and SLA adherence.
  • Coordinate SaaS releases, upgrades, and vendor-led changes, including impact assessment and business communications.
  • Validate vendor patching, security updates, and release notes for enterprise impact.
  • Support SaaS configuration changes, user provisioning, role management, and integrations.
  • Partner with InfoSec and Compliance to support risk assessments, audits, and vendor reviews.

Incident, Request & Service Management

  • Provide L2/L3 support for incidents and service requests across SaaS and self-managed applications.
  • Collaborate with GSD / Client Services for L1 support and escalation workflows.

Job Responsibilities:

Self-Managed Application Support

  • Perform application maintenance for self-managed applications, including deployment of application updates, patches, and fixes.

SaaS (Managed Service) Application Support

Governance, Documentation & Lifecycle Management

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

  • Preparar reportes ejecutivos periódicos para la alta dirección; desarrollar presentaciones para comités, mesas regionales y eventos estratégicos, y documentar las decisiones clave, lecciones aprendidas y avances del proyecto.
  • Sistematizar los aprendizajes y buenas prácticas del proyecto para generar insumos técnicos y conceptuales para la Plataforma C3 del FLAR, difundiendo y socializando los resultados en espacios como workshops, webinars y foros cuando sea solicitado.


Requisitos


  • Profesional en economía, ingeniería, administración, finanzas, sistemas, derecho, relaciones internacionales o áreas afines. Deseable, posgrado en gestión de proyectos, innovación, sistemas financieros o transformación digital.
  • Experiencia mínima comprobada de 5 años en la gestión de proyectos complejos y multiactor, preferiblemente en proyectos relacionados con sistemas de pagos, infraestructura financiera o en entornos de bancos centrales, entidades públicas u organismos internacionales, y certificación en gestión de proyectos (PMP® o PRINCE2® Practitioner).
  • Niveles de idiomas mínimos requeridos: español C1, inglés C1, portugués C1.


Conocimientos técnicos

  • Dominio de metodologías formales de gestión de proyectos (PMI, PRINCE2 o enfoques híbridos)
  • Experiencia en el uso de herramientas de planificación y seguimiento (MS Project u otras equivalentes),
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de pagos, pagos inmediatos y/o infraestructura financiera
  • Conocimiento y uso estratégico de herramientas de inteligencia artificial orientado a mejorar la planificación, seguimiento, análisis y reporte del proyecto.


Tipo de contratación


Prestación de servicios, a un (1) año.



Si cumples con los requerimientos del perfil envíanos tu hoja de vida al correo electrónico .


Cierre de la convocatoria el 8 de marzo de 2026.

title: Customer Success Specialist,Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Global Executive Recrutier
description:
Global Executive Recrutier - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM – 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end

Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.
