title: Mid/Senior Devops
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join a strategic cloud migration initiative, transitioning workloads from Azure to AWS within a structured modernization program.

This professional will play a key role in supporting the technical execution of the migration, ensuring infrastructure standardization, automation, CI/CD pipeline implementation, environment readiness, observability, and post-migration operational validation.


The project follows a Lift & Shift / Replatform approach, covering infrastructure preparation, security, networking, service equivalency mapping, migration execution, testing, stabilization, and post-cutover operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities


  • Prepare and standardize AWS environments (VPC, IAM, networking, security, logging).
  • Support migrations using AWS MGN, DMS, and SCT.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
  • Implement monitoring and observability (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana).
  • Validate application, database, and network functionality post-migration.
  • Support performance, scalability, and security testing.
  • Contribute to documentation and runbooks.


What do you need to know?


  • Cloud & Migration: AWS (EC2, EKS/ECS, S3, Aurora, VPC, ALB/NLB, Route 53, IAM, KMS), Azure (VMs, AKS, SQL, App Services)
  • DevOps & Automation: Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps), Python/Bash/PowerShell
  • Migration Tools: AWS MGN, DMS, SCT
  • Integrations & Monitoring: Kafka, Snowflake, Elasticsearch, Datadog
  • Language: Fluent English


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest

  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship

  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + UX/UI + AI-Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley–based product company building a next‑generation B2B single-page application used daily by enterprise customers. We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who is both a hands-on React expert and a strong UX/UI thinker, someone who can own the user experience end‑to‑end, from concept to polished production implementation.


This is a role for a self-directed, highly motivated engineer who can hit the ground running, collaborate closely with product/design, and loves leveraging the latest AI tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and iteration.


What You Will Do

  • Architect, build, and deliver modern, high-performance React applications for a complex B2B SaaS product.
  • Translate product concepts and user workflows into frictionless UX flows, wireframes, and pixel-perfect UI components.
  • Collaborate with Product, and Backend teams to shape features from idea to release.
  • Implement real-time features using SignalR and other websocket technologies.
  • Work with AI agents and tools daily for coding, refactoring, UI generation, documentation, and test creation.
  • Write automated tests with Playwright and other testing frameworks.
  • Drive UI performance, accessibility, and maintainability best practices.
  • Think holistically: not just “take tasks,” but help shape the product, the experience, and the architecture.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Full US Pacific Time availability (not partial overlap).
  • Fluent verbal and written English; comfortable with daily video-based collaboration .
  • 5+ years of hands-on React experience (hooks, context, state management, component architecture).
  • Strong UX/UI sensibility—capable of producing or improving wireframes, interaction flows, and visual details.
  • Experience working directly from Figma or similar UI tools.
  • Experience with real-time applications (SignalR preferred but not required).
  • Comfort with Node.js for lightweight tooling or UI-supporting backends.
  • Familiarity with Electron , WebSockets , and HTML5 .
  • Regular, disciplined use of AI tools for development.
  • Strong communication, accountability, and a bias toward problem-solving.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products and complex user workflows.
  • Understanding of frontend architecture patterns at scale.
  • Background in design systems or component libraries.
  • Experience in performance tuning for real-time or heavy-data UIs.


Who You Are

  • A team player with strong ownership and bias for action.
  • Someone who enjoys “figuring things out” rather than waiting for instructions.
  • A builder who can think outside the box , challenge assumptions, and propose better solutions.
  • A believer in AI-accelerated engineering and modern best practices.
  • A product-mindset engineer who cares deeply about user experience—from pixels to workflows.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a tight‑knit, fast-moving team where your work directly shapes the product experience. You’ll have the autonomy to influence UI/UX direction, introduce best practices, and work with a modern AI-enabled workflow that rewards creativity and initiative.

If you are a senior frontend engineer who crafts beautiful interfaces, moves fast, and wants to push the edge of what AI-accelerated development can do , we’d love to talk.

title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:

title: Vendedor(a) - Outlet
description:
Quem somos?

A Breton construiu uma história sólida e se tornou referência no mercado de mobiliário de alto padrão. A trajetória da empresa é marcada pela sofisticação, design diferenciado e compromisso com a responsabilidade ambiental e social, sendo reconhecida como uma das principais referências do segmento no Brasil.

Pautada pelos valores de família e conduzida por uma família, a marca tem expertise na criação, desenvolvimento e produção de mobiliário com alto valor agregado, que passa por uma curadoria afiada de uma equipe multidisciplinar preparada para atender as mais diversas demandas de um mercado exigente e que se moderniza a todo momento.

A Breton assume sua responsabilidade com a sustentabilidade e está comprometida em adotar práticas em todas as etapas de sua cadeia produtiva, buscando um melhor aproveitamento dos recursos naturais. Uma das conquistas da marca é o selo Carbono Negativo, obtido pela primeira vez, em 2022. Nos anos de 2020 e 2021 a Breton já era reconhecida como Carbono Neutro, ou seja, compensou todas as suas emissões.

Com 20 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil, o principal diferencial da Breton é a personalização. Cada peça é 100% personalizável, oferecendo aos clientes a escolha entre medidas, tecidos e acabamentos.

Saiba mais em ou @bretonoficial.


Na Breton , acreditamos que cada ambiente conta uma história.

Com design, sofisticação e cuidado em cada detalhe, buscamos transformar a experiência dos nossos clientes, oferecendo móveis que unem beleza, conforto e exclusividade.

No nosso Outlet , oferecemos peças especiais do nosso portfólio com condições diferenciadas, e buscamos alguém que, assim como nós, tenha brilho nos olhos para encantar clientes e transformar atendimentos em experiências memoráveis.


Principais Atribuições:


  • Receber e atender clientes na loja, apresentando as peças disponíveis no showroom e no estoque.
  • Apoiar o cliente na escolha de produtos, oferecendo informações e transmitindo confiança.
  • Realizar vendas e registrar pedidos no sistema, acompanhando todo o processo até a entrega.
  • Manter a organização do espaço de loja e auxiliar no controle do estoque.
  • Contribuir para que a experiência Breton seja percebida em cada detalhe, do primeiro contato ao pós-venda.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em vendas no varejo (móveis, decoração ou segmentos de luxo serão um diferencial).
  • Formação em Administração, Arquitetura, Design de Interiores ou áreas correlatas (completo ou em andamento);
  • Facilidade de comunicação, simpatia e vontade de encantar.
  • Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.
  • Conhecimento básico de informática.


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Vivência em lojas de alto padrão.
  • Afinidade com design e interiores.
  • Paixão por criar conexões verdadeiras com pessoas.


  • Local de atuação: Outlet Breton – Pinheiros /SP.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.

  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • applications

  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team

Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.

title: Desenvolvedor ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.

description:

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.
